description: Check the status of a scan job previously started with trigger_page_scan. Returns the current phase (pending, running, done, or failed) and, once done, whether the scan completed with errors. Scans usually finish within 120 seconds end to end, so a "running" or "pending" phase shortly after triggering is expected, not a stall -- wait at least 15-20 seconds between calls instead of polling back to back.
name: get_scan_status
title: Get scan status
